name: Burundian Ubugali

name: Burundian Isombe
description: Isombe, pounded cassava leaves stewed with peanuts, a beloved dish shared with neighboring Rwanda and DR Congo - real cassava leaves aren't a distinct item here, so spinach stands in.

steps_detailed: Marinate the beef in the garlic and oil for 15-20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill, turning, 8-10 minutes, until charred and cooked through.

name: Burundian Chapati
description: Chapati, a soft, layered flatbread, reflects genuine East African Indian culinary influence, found across Burundi as it is throughout the wider region.
steps_detailed: Work the flour with warm water and half the oil into a soft dough. Rest 20 minutes.
Roll thin, brush with the remaining oil, and coil before flattening to build real layers.
Cook in a hot, dry pan, 2-3 minutes per side, until golden.
